name: Frontend Regression Check
description: Re-check the major flows touched by a change in the shared Browser session, and leave unrelated pages alone unless the change reaches them.

permissionsRequired.reason: Open the flow the change touched.
Follow that flow in the same session.
Capture the flow after the change.
Step through the controls in the flow.
See if the flow raised a page error.

validation.rule: The flows that were rechecked are ones the change touched, and each result cites a browser_screenshot or session navigation. Untouched areas were not broadly retested without a reason.
